ATAK Already installed - Connecting to takserver

slides.title: Getting online
slides.html:
• With Deploy App there are the quick way and the backup manual way, to connect to your server.
  • This guide covers the quick way aka. Auto Import Connection.

slides.title: 2. Tap Auto Import package
slides.html: • Then tap the button ATAK: Auto import package

slides.title: 3. ATAK Auto-Import
slides.html: • The Auto-Import button will open ATAK and ask for importing a server configuration package. Press the button to do so.

slides.title: 3. Approve loading the server config
slides.html: • ATAK should open and ask about importing a package with a long link. Tap Yes to proceed.

slides.title: 4. That's it! You're online
slides.html: • That's it! The green TAK icon shows that the connection is OK.

slides.title: 5. If the question about importing package did not appear
slides.html: • Sometimes ATAK fails to open the import dialog for Auto-Importing server configuration package. Make sure ATAK is running and try again.

blocks.html: After successfull connection to takserver, continue to Receive Feeds
